title: つかんで移動 /Grab and Move
author: Yukio7Ishihara

status.label: Waiting for requested translation
status.detail: Upstream asked the author to translate the Japanese issue body to English; the title became bilingual, but the body remains untranslated.

next_action.label: Wait for author translation
next_action.reason: Do not repeat the existing request while Needs-Author-Feedback remains active.

judgment.rationale: The feature can be understood from automated synthesis, but upstream explicitly requested an English translation and the author has not supplied it.
evidence: The request is to use a mouse side button as the Grab and Move activation modifier for mouse-only move/resize.
Automated triage explicitly asks for an English title and description.
The title was changed to include Grab and Move, but the body remains Japanese and Needs-Author-Feedback is active.
#49044 asks for right Alt/AltGr, not a mouse button, so it is only related.
judgment.recommended_action: Preserve waiting-on-author state until the requested English description is supplied; then evaluate mouse-button activation separately from #49044.

issue_context.summary: The author wants Grab and Move activation to work entirely from the mouse by assigning a side button as the modifier.
known_information: The body says only Windows or Alt can be selected and asks to assign the modifier role to mouse button 4 or similar.
The scenario is moving and resizing windows using only the mouse.
Grab and Move currently models activation as an Alt/Win enum and uses mouse buttons separately for move/resize.
inferences: Supporting a mouse modifier requires an input-model decision, not just another keyboard virtual key.
The request is adjacent to left-handed accessibility issue #49044 but has different semantics.
issue_context.analysis: The existing author request is still active, so Pulse should not expose another request or design approval. After translation, maintainers can decide how a held mouse modifier coexists with move/resize buttons.
initial_investigation: Read the body and both comments, including the automated English synthesis.
Inspected Grab and Move source and confirmed only Alt and Win modifier modes.
Compared #49044 and confirmed it requests right Alt/AltGr rather than mouse activation.

information_gaps.information: An English translation of the issue description.
information_gaps.why_needed: This is the explicit active upstream author request and removes durable requirement ambiguity.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Edit the issue body or add a comment with the English description and scenario.
